name: CaseHardGradientElementFill
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "hard-gradient-element-fill" (non-stroke-ink). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: background-image: linear-gradient on the ELEMENT (not a pseudo) COMPUTED-ENRICHED (extract/computed): unlabeled styled channels minted from computed-style capture of @ds-contracts/conformance@0.1.0 in headless Chromium 151.0.7922.34; overflow channels in the sibling extension file.
